column1: Housing census – Buildings – Time series from 2011 on
column2: The Housing census included in the Register-based census and in the Register-based labour market statistics is a complete survey of the buildings and dwellings and their attributes for the reference date 31 October. The Register-based census and the Register-based labour market statistics are conducted by using information from administrative registers. The main data source for the Housing census is the Buildings- and dwellings register of Statistics Austria. The characteristics and definitions are based on the EU regulation on population and housing censuses and the Austrian Register-based census act (BGBl. I. Nr. 33/2006). For a detailed description of the methods used and for further information see: https://www.statistik.at/en/statistics/population-and-society/housing/stock-of-buildings https://www.statistik.at/en/statistics/population-and-society/housing/stock-of-dwellings https://www.statistik.at/fileadmin/shared/QM/Standarddokumentationen/B_1/std_b_abgestimmte_erwerbsstatistik.pdf (German only) This database contains the results for buildings. Buildings are independent structures containing one or more dwellings or other spaces, covered by a roof and enclosed within external walls or dividing walls which extend from the foundations to the roof, and are designed for residential or other purposes. .) Territorial structure of 2023. .) Updating: annually last update: [2025-06-16] .) Contact details: Directorate social statistics For general enquiries: +43 1 711 28-7070 In case of special enquiries please contact registerzaehlung@statistik.gv.at .)
